entries.details_markdown: A launch can be edited until the end of its launch day, or for 12 hours after it goes out if that's later. Then the original post is locked, so what people voted on stays what they saw, and news goes in updates, which stay open. Its maker sees when editing closes on the slop page and the edit page. The promo video isn't locked: a moderator approves each one anyway.

entries.summary: Search the wall, and pick several categories at once
entries.details_markdown: The wall's categories are chips now: pick as many as you like, turn one off by clicking it again, or select all and clear them in one go. A search box sits above them and finds slops by what they do as well as by their words, so “budget” turns up an expense tracker. Search and chips work together, and both live in the address, so a filtered view can be shared and Back steps through it.

entries.summary: The race clock reads hours and minutes all day
entries.details_markdown: The countdown to midnight UTC used to switch to minutes and seconds in the last hour, so 58 minutes left read 58:45. It now reads hours and minutes all day (00:58 in the last hour, still in red) and never shows 00:00 while the race is open. Hover over it, or press and hold on a phone, to see the seconds too.

entries.summary: An out-of-date moderation page asks you to try again instead of breaking
entries.details_markdown: A moderation page left open across an update showed "Something broke" when you approved a video. Now nothing happens, and you get the current page with a note to try again.
